My College Experience and Future Goals

My College Experience

My name is Christian Vazquez, and I'm currently in my second year at CUNY City Tech. My college experience has been good so far. I'm enjoying the classes I take and the professors I've met, but I also work a lot outside of school, which can make managing my time difficult at times. My favorite part of college is being able to learn more about something I'm passionate about while meeting new people who share similar interests.

Outside of school, I enjoy graphic design, playing video games, listening to music, and spending time with my loved ones. Graphic design has always been one of my biggest interests, and I enjoy finding new ways to improve my skills and express my creativity. I want to continue learning and building my experience throughout college.

My Future Career Goals

After graduating, my dream is to work as a lead designer in the marketing or apparel industry. I would love to work on creative projects, develop visual identities, and help brands communicate through design. Being able to turn something I'm passionate about into my career is one of my biggest goals.

Eventually, I want to gain enough experience to lead creative projects and collaborate with other designers. I know it takes time and hard work to reach that position, so I want to keep improving my skills and learning as much as I can along the way.

A Quote That Inspires Me

Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works. — Steve Jobs

My Interests

Some of my favorite things to do are creating digital designs, playing video games, and listening to music.
I also enjoy spending quality time with my friends and family.
